root: Uni-CLI 0.223.0 is the local computer-use context release: `compute capture` combines accessibility refs, screenshot evidence, image metadata, and replayable capture trajectory into one packet.
`compute capture --save-reference` writes local app-shot artifacts, while `--copy-reference` copies `[app-shots ...]` markup for agent-to-agent handoff.
The `computer-use.capture` MCP tool exposes the same capture/reference workflow, bringing the computer-use profile to 16 tools.
`compute capture` is discoverable through `unicli search "Appshots"`, `unicli list --site compute`, `unicli describe compute capture`, and MCP `unicli_list`.
Capture metadata now externalizes image bytes, keeps SHA-256/dimensions/coordinate-space evidence, and strips geometry/raw accessibility object pointers from agent handoff text.
`doctor compute --providers` adds neutral optional provider discovery for external/platform provider commands and visual-model fallback configuration.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.223.0 是 local computer-use context 发布版：`compute capture` 把 accessibility refs、截图证据、图片元数据和可回放 capture trajectory 合成一个 packet。
`compute capture --save-reference` 会写入本地 app-shot artifacts，`--copy-reference` 会复制 `[app-shots ...]` markup，方便 Agent 之间交接上下文。
`computer-use.capture` MCP tool 暴露同一套 capture/reference workflow，computer-use profile 增至 16 个工具。
`compute capture` 现在可通过 `unicli search "Appshots"`、`unicli list --site compute`、`unicli describe compute capture` 和 MCP `unicli_list` 发现。
Capture metadata 现在外置图片字节，保留 SHA-256、尺寸和 coordinate-space 证据，同时从 handoff 文本中去掉坐标和 raw accessibility object 指针。
`doctor compute --providers` 新增中性的 optional provider discovery，用于外部/平台 provider command 和 visual-model fallback 配置。
